description: The AI content strategist of the page. Instructions = the strategy, the manager's goals, its playbook of learned lessons and its recent work log; it acts only through 'Content agent: tools'. Runs when the manager writes in Lark (answer sent back), when something happens (an approval or rejection), in a daily shift at 08:00 (plans, drafts, asks) and in a weekly review on Monday 08:30 (reads every signal, updates its playbook, reports to the manager). Every run is saved to content_agent.events as its work log.
